propositions: Read-only derivations compute llm_call_proxy and latency from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics only, never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block.
cost_per_accepted_change sums llm_calls from REVIEW_RESULT records and divides by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records (accepted closes), returning None when no accepted closes exist.
first_pass_verification computes the fraction of tickets whose earliest COMPLETION_VERDICT record (oldest-first by filename scan) is completion_verifier_pass_v1.
env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 record with the next same-gate PASS record, computing duration as timestamp delta; errors with no following same-gate PASS are unclosed intervals.

Raw ordered scan of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files per ticket distinguishes schema types (plan_review_result_v2, completion_verifier_pass_v1, gate_error_v1) by data.schema and verdict fields.
Metrics register into src/rebar/metrics/registry.py with source='sidecar' and confidence='high' (is_authoritative=True).
